title: Modality Discrepancy Transformer for Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2609.19148v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ambivalence and hesitancy (A/H) are affective states in which individuals express contradictory signals across facial, vocal, and linguistic channels. Automatically recognising A/H in clinical videos requires detecting cross-modal disagreement -- the signal that standard fusion methods suppress. Based on the conflict-aware multimodal fusion framework of Bekhouche et al., we present the Modality Discrepancy Transformer (MDT). MDT enriches the original 6-token design to a 9-token representation comprising three modality embeddings, three absolute-difference features, and three Hadamard-product discrepancy features learned through linear projections. These nine tokens undergo Transformer self-attention, with FiLM-based text-conditioned modulation and LoRA fine-tuning as core architectural components. A text-guided late fusion branch blends a text-only auxiliary head with the full multimodal output at inference. On the BAH dataset from the 3

translated_title: 用于矛盾与迟疑识别的模态差异Transformer
translated_abstract: 矛盾与迟疑（A/H）是一种情感状态，个体会在面部、语音和语言等通道上表达出相互矛盾的信号。要在临床视频中自动识别A/H，需要检测跨模态的不一致性——而这正是标准融合方法所抑制的信号。基于Bekhouche等人提出的冲突感知多模态融合框架，我们提出了模态差异Transformer（MDT）。MDT将原始的6-token设计扩展为9-token表示，包含三个模态嵌入、三个绝对差特征以及三个通过线性投影学习的Hadamard积差异特征。这九个token经过Transformer自注意力机制处理，其中基于FiLM的文本条件调制和LoRA微调是其核心架构组件。文本引导的后期融合分支在推理阶段将仅文本的辅助头与完整的多模态输出进行融合。在来自第3届BAH数据集（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出模态差异Transformer（MDT），将跨模态矛盾信号显式建模为9-token表示（模态嵌入、绝对差特征与Hadamard积差异特征），结合FiLM文本条件调制、LoRA微调及文本引导后期融合，实现临床视频中矛盾与迟疑情感状态的自动识别。
en_tdlr: We propose the Modality Discrepancy Transformer (MDT), which explicitly models cross-modal disagreement through a 9-token representation of modality embeddings, absolute-difference and Hadamard-product discrepancy features, combined with FiLM text-conditioned modulation, LoRA fine-tuning, and text-guided late fusion for recognizing ambivalence and hesitancy in clinical videos.
